remarks: *BACKUP OFFERS UNDER REVIEW* Private North Stamford Oasis w/ Over $250K in Premium Upgrades-Nestled in a serene & secluded setting, this beautifully maintained North Stamford retreat offers resort-style living at its finest. Thoughtfully designed for entertaining in tranquil spaces, the lush, landscaped grounds create a private sanctuary. Outdoor Living Redefined-Step into a backyard paradise featuring heated Gunite pool, pool house w/ half bath & kitchenette plus a well-equipped outdoor kitchen & outdoor shower. Enjoy year-round relaxation in the brand-new Caldera Makena 6-person hot tub, surrounded by curated landscaping, a custom stone patio, walkways, & cozy outdoor firepit. A 20-zone irrigation system & outdoor lighting ensure effortless maintenance & ambiance day & night. A Self-Sufficient, Peaceful Escape-Cultivate your own produce in the irrigated vegetable garden w/ greenhouse and koi pond w/ waterfall feature for a tranquil focal point. Vinyl fencing w/ custom gates ensures total privacy & security. Modern Upgrades for Effortless Living-offering the perfect blend of luxury & practicality: new home gym, new well system, pH-balanced water filtration, upgraded electrical panel w/ generator hook-up, new water heater & pool filter, multi-zone outdoor sound system, extensive stonework, marble entry, & integrated smart home & security camera systems. A rare combination offering the best of indoor-outdoor living in one of Stamford's most desirable neighborhoods.
